_comment: Validate-mode golden: a synopsis `\ref` group header naming a
stable name that is not a section in the document. Hand-written (no
Clang needed, so this runs on every lane), because what the rule reads
-- a SpanKind::Ref span's payload -- is already in the IR; the rule
just compares that payload against the document's section set.
`gadget`'s synopsis carries two Ref spans, the shape an out-of-line
check_coverage's Routed-only rule does not see either of them): one
names `gadget.a`, a real section below, and must stay silent; the other
names `gadget.b`, which no `\rSec` opens, and must be the sole finding.
`widget`'s synopsis is the negative control -- a second class whose one
